people.name: Nebuchadnezzar
people.line: Emperor of Babylon who conquered Judah

translations.web: At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
translations.bsb: Now at the end of the time specified by the king, the chief official presented them to Nebuchadnezzar.
translations.kjv: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in, then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
translations.asv: And at the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
